section.sectionSummaryBrief: Although "zaken ba bayamim" refers to Atik Yomin, it is explained that this refers to Arich Anpin, not Atik itself, and Avraham attained this level of "zaken ba bayamim" through his service, connecting it to Torah and mitzvos.
section.t: And although also "zaken ba bayamim" is the level of Atik Yomin,
as it is brought in the Midrash,
that the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Avraham: "Come and wear My garments," as it is said, "And Avraham was old, coming with days,"
and the Kohanic gifts explain that this "coming with days" is a garment of the Holy One, blessed be He, because the Holy One, blessed be He, is called
"Atik Yomin,"
[and the Tzemach Tzedek
adds that also "zaken"
(the beard)
is a garment of the Holy One, blessed be He,
for regarding Atik Yomin it is written,
"His garment is white as snow,"
which is
the level of the thirteen tikkunei d'ikna],
it can be said,
that the intention in this is
(not to Atik itself,
but rather)
to Arich, which is also called by the name Atik Yomin,
[and it can be said that this that Arich is called by the name Atik Yomin is because the seven lower sefiros of Atik are clothed within it],
but "Kol" is Atik itself.
And furthermore,
that within Atik itself, it is the level of the first three sefiros of Atik that are not clothed in Arich,
and up to the level of the pnimiyus of Atik and higher,
and as mentioned above
(section 1)
from the maamar that "Kol" is the level of the essential concealment.
And this is that the matter of "zaken ba bayamim" is attributed by the verse to Avraham
("And Avraham was old, coming with days")
but not so regarding "Kol," where it says "and Hashem blessed Avraham with everything,"
because this that Avraham had the level of "zaken ba bayamim,"
which is the externality of Kesser,
he drew this down through his service.
And it can be said,
that this is also the connection of the interpretation that "zaken ba bayamim" is a garment of the Holy One, blessed be He, with the interpretation
that "zaken" is one who has acquired wisdom
(Torah)
and "ba bayamim" is the garments of the mitzvos,
because this that Avraham had the garment of the Holy One, blessed be He,
he drew this down through his Torah and mitzvos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: "Zaken" and "ba bayamim" are two distinct levels in Arich—the inner source of Torah and the encompassing source of mitzvos—which Avraham drew through his service, whereas "Kol" is the level of Atik that comes solely from above.
section.t: And this can be explained in more detail,
that "zaken" and "ba bayamim" are two levels.
"Zaken," which is the thirteen tikkunei d'ikna,
is in the Mocha Stima'ah of Arich,
and "ba bayamim" is Arich itself
[for this that Arich is called by the name Atik Yomin
is primarily in the atzmiyus of Arich],
the Gulgalta of Arich.
And this is the connection of these two matters
("zaken" and "ba bayamim")
above
(the garment of the Holy One, blessed be He)
with these two matters in the service of man,
because the Mocha Stima'ah of Arich is pnimi,
the root of Torah,
and the Gulgalta of Arich is makif,
the root of mitzvos.
And through Avraham's engagement in Torah,
"zaken who acquired wisdom,"
he drew down the level of the d'ikna and Mocha Stima'ah of Arich
("zaken"),
and through his being "ba bayamim,"
the garments of the mitzvos,
he drew down the level of the Gulgalta
of Arich
("ba bayamim").
But not so "Kol," which is the level of Atik,
arousal from below does not reach there,
and therefore it is written, "and Hashem blessed Avraham with everything,"
an arousal from above that comes from above.
However, this arousal from above
dwells and is revealed specifically after the completion of the service
(and the arousal from above that comes through the arousal from below),
therefore,
that which Hashem blessed Avraham with everything was specifically after he stood in ten trials,
as mentioned above
(section 2 at its beginning).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Within the level of "Kol" (Atik) there are gradations: one attained through negative commandments relates to the chain of descent, while the higher one attained through trials is completely transcendent and separate.
section.t: And behold, also within the level of "Kol"
(Atik)
which is above "ba bayamim"
(Arich)
there are several levels.
And as understood from what is explained in the maamar
(beginning "And Avraham was old")
of the Tzemach Tzedek,
that at first he says,
that Avraham merited the level of "Kol" through the fulfillment of negative commandments, and also in this level of "Kol" he says it is the pnimiyus of Atik
[as explained there,
that this that "Hashem blessed Avraham with everything" is after it is said "ba bayamim,"
because "yamim" are positive commandments,
and through the service of "ba bayamim," the fulfillment of positive commandments, he merited the level of Arich
(the level of "ba bayamim" above),
but not so this that he merited the level of "Kol," which he merited through the fulfillment of negative commandments, is the pnimiyus of Atik which is above Arich],
and afterwards he says that Avraham merited this through the ten trials
(as above section 2 from the Midrash),
it can be said,
that the level of "Kol" that he merited through the trials is more elevated than the level of "Kol" that he merited through the fulfillment of negative commandments.
And the explanation in this can be said,
that the level of Atik
("Kol")
that he merited through the fulfillment of negative commandments,
has a connection to the chain of descent,
and therefore,
the service of man through which he merits this is service that depends on his will
(i.e., service that is in order and gradation),
except that within this itself,
since Atik is above the chain of descent,
therefore the service is not in action but in refraining and non-action,
negation.
But not so the level of Atik
("Kol")
that he merited through the trials,
it is completely removed and separate,
and as mentioned above
(section 1)
from the maamar that it is the essential concealment.
And therefore,
when the service of man depends on his will,
it has no likeness
to this level of Atik that is removed and completely separate.
And only through the service of trials, which does not depend on the will of man
[for it is forbidden for a person to place himself in a trial,
and furthermore, we are commanded to pray "do not bring us into trial"],
specifically through this does one merit the revelation of this level.
